title: Listing Add-Ons
description: Manage optional add-ons that providers attach to their listings.

help.title: About Listing add-ons
help.overview: An add-on is an optional extra a buyer can attach when ordering a listing, such as express delivery or an extra revision. It belongs to one listing and adds its own price and, optionally, extra delivery days.

sections.title: Fields
items: Listing is required and fixed; only that listing's provider can create or delete its add-ons.
Name is what the buyer sees. Price amount and currency are what it adds.
Delivery days, if set, are added to the listing's or package's delivery window.

sections.title: Ordering with add-ons
items: Only add-ons of the listing being ordered can be selected, each once.
Each add-on must use the same currency as the order (the package's, or the listing's when there is no package); a mismatch blocks the order.
Deleting is a soft delete. An add-on cannot be restored while its listing is deleted.
